jobs.title: Partner Growth Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT RUNDOO ℹ️

Our mission is to empower independent supply stores with best-in-class technology. Think of your local hardware store or mom-and-pop nursery—these are our clients. From paint to lumber to flooring, over 200,000 such stores across the country sell over $1T of building materials annually using outdated, on-premises systems. We’re aiming to help them modernize so that they can continue to thrive.

Backed by leading investors including Battery, Bessemer and CRV, we've raised $48M across four rounds and are growing quickly: We're live in over 500 stores across the USA, Canada, and the Caribbean, and integrated with over 20 industry partners. Our team is made up of builders, sellers, and industry veterans with a shared goal: to bring modern technology to an overlooked industry.




ABOUT THE ROLE 💼

The role is based in Redwood City, with regular travel to co-op markets, partner events, and stores across the country.

Marketing's job at Rundoo is to create the conditions for more deals to come through, and partnerships is one of our highest-leverage ways to do it. Our buyers already trust their co-ops and manufacturers: Benjamin Moore, AllPro, Emery Jensen, House Hasson, Blish-Mize, Orgill, Florida Hardware, LBM Advantage, and more. Partner referrals convert at a very high rate, and our goal is to shift the majority of new qualified leads (MQLs) to marketing-, partner-, and inbound-sourced, the inverse of where we are today. That engine runs through you.

As Partner Growth Manager, you own the partner and co-op channel end to end: roughly twenty partner relationships across our verticals, the referral program that runs through their reps, and the co-marketing that puts Rundoo in front of their members. Campaigns are the unit of work here, and the Campaigns DB is your operating system: every partner blast, magazine, referral promo, and rate-card placement lives there as a tracked campaign.

This is a hands-on operator role. You will build collateral, run co-op e-blasts and webinars, structure and grow the referral program, and turn a list of partner reps into a system Account Executives actually use. You report to the Head of Marketing, who brings the strategy and domain expertise and orchestrates the partnerships triangle (you on the reps and marketing relationships, the Events & Conferences Specialist on the shows, and leadership at the exec level). You work alongside the Data Science team, who build the enrichment and data behind your partner-rep tooling. You bring the relationships, the collateral, and the discipline to make partner-sourced pipeline predictable.

This is a prove-it-and-grow role. The partner channel already converts well, and the ceiling is high (the working thesis is that partners and conferences together can drive millions in new ARR and eventually support a full team). As you prove the channel out, the scope, the budget, the team under you, and the level grow with it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AS THE PARTNER GROWTH MANAGER AT RUNDOO 🗒️

 - Own and grow the referral program. Run the quarterly incentive campaigns that keep partner reps sending us stores (a recent referral contest returned $7 for every $1 spent), the standing rewards ($50 per qualified meeting, $500 per sign), a conference-season booth-selfie incentive, and an affiliate / content-referral track that also earns Rundoo backlinks and AEO/SEO visibility.

 - Map and own the partner universe. You will build and own relationships with roughly twenty partners across Paint, Hardware, Farm & Feed, Lawn & Garden, and Lumber. For each one, know the rep contacts, the marketing-manager contact, the exec contact, the last touch, the ARR it has generated, and what is still on the table.

 - Build relationship with each partner. Rep level (referrals and enablement), marketing-manager level (rate cards, member e-blasts, mailers, magazines, and sponsored placements in their regular member communications), and, with leadership, the exec level.

 - Turn partner spend into pipeline. Work with the Head of Marketing and Events Specialist to negotiate per-partner rate cards and marquee packages, and run case studies, referral promos, and special offers through them. The thesis: a serious commitment to a marquee partner should return multiple large deals.

 - Enable Account Executives. With the Data Science team, turn partner-rep contact, territory, and coverage data into the maps tool AEs use (who covers which store, who's active, and the introduction path), and coach partner reps on value-based selling and pricing discipline so referrals arrive better-qualified.

 - Run per-vertical partner campaigns. Pre-show invites, social announcements, ads, email blasts, and post-show follow-up, unified per partner in the Campaigns DB (a paint-partner campaign this month, a hardware-partner campaign next).

 - Own a growing partner-sourced sales pipeline number. Expand the definition of a partner opportunity from your direct referrals to any partner channel-sourced opportunity, and move the north star to partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won ARR.

 - Land the credibility moments. Get our CEO and customers onto the trade podcasts run by partners, and use announcements and case studies as a partner-facing credibility moment.




REQUIREMENTS ☑️

We care more about whether you can grow partner-sourced pipeline than about a title history. The ideal candidate builds the collateral, works the relationships, and owns a referral number rather than waiting to be handed a plan.

Core Competencies:

 - Partner operator - you build the collateral, run the co-op e-blasts and webinars, and work the relationships yourself

 - Owns a partner-sourced number - you measure yourself on partner- and referral-sourced pipeline and ARR, not on partners "engaged"

 - Enables the front line - you turn partner data into a tool AEs actually open and use, and you coach reps on how to talk about Rundoo

 - Relationship builder across levels - you're comfortable with reps, with a co-op's marketing manager, and with an exec, and you know which conversation to have with whom

 - Ship-and-iterate temperament - you'd rather ship a working referral motion for one co-op this month and expand it than design the perfect program for next quarter




VALUABLE EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years in partner marketing, channel marketing, co-marketing, or a partnerships / referral role where you owned pipeline

 - Standing up or scaling a referral or affiliate program

 - Building co-branded collateral and running co-op or manufacturer joint campaigns (e-blasts, webinars, one-pagers, magazine placements)

 - Hands-on with Salesforce: accounts, contacts, campaigns, and how referrals are tracked and attributed

 - Working with a sales team to enable them with partner or account intelligence

 - SMB or owner-operator customers, and ideally distributor / co-op / buying-group ecosystems, rather than enterprise targeting




TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Comfortable in a CRM (Salesforce): accounts, contacts, campaigns, and clean partner-to-pipeline reporting

 - Comfortable with spreadsheets, lists, and outreach tooling, and with partnering with a Marketing Engineer on the enrichment behind partner-rep data

 - Able to work from Redwood City and travel to co-op markets, partner events, and stores as needed




BONUS POINTS 🌟

 - Familiarity with paint, hardware, building materials, farm and feed, lawn and garden, or related industries and their co-ops and buying groups (Benjamin Moore, AllPro, Emery Jensen, House Hasson, Blish-Mize, Orgill, Florida Hardware, LBM Advantage, HDA / HDN, NHPA)

 - Experience negotiating rate cards, sponsorships, or media placements with partners

 - Comfort using AI tools to draft collateral, partner outreach, and enablement material at speed
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS 🎤

 - Intro Call (30 min) - Remote: 
   
   - Intro conversation with Shannon to get to know you. 

 - Round 1 (30 min) - Remote: 
   
   - Titus, Head of Marketing, will go more in depth on the role and your experience.  

 - Take home exercise (paid) 
   
   - Build a partner plan: assume we are sponsoring a large Lumber distributor as a preferred vendor, and with that we will be able to send physical postcards, email blasts, banner ads, magazine ads, webinars and newsletter inserts. Design and build a reusable set of tools to produce sample materials you would use in this campaign and propose cadence to hit $500k in pipeline.

 - Round 2 (2 hours) - Remote: 
   
   - Three conversations, plus lunch in our office: 
     
     1. (1 hr) Review your take-home and walk the hiring team through your decisions and assumptions
     
     2. (30 mins) Conversation with Addy about events and conferences and how you'll work together
     
     3. (30 mins) Conversation with Zach, one of our Product Managers, about how you'll work cross-functionally with Product. 

 - Founder Chat (15 min) - Remote: 
   
   - Conversation with our CEO, Nick.




ABOUT THE TEAM 👥

Here is the current makeup of our team:

 - Titus https://www.linkedin.com/in/tituscapilnean/, Head of Marketing: (Owns strategy, domain expertise, and orchestration of the partnerships triangle.) Over a 15+ year career, I've been the first GTM/Marketing hire at five startups, embedding with founding teams to find product-market fit before the company spends money scaling. I build Marketing & GTM functions from scratch, ship code, close deals, and design the systems that turn early traction into repeatable revenue. Love to 🏂 and 🏍️. Claude 🤖 certified.

 - Amrit https://www.linkedin.com/in/amrit-kwatra-87066612a/, Data Science: (Owns the enrichment, data, and attribution plumbing) Studied CS & English at Cornell; Data Scientist at Enigma; Public Interest Technology Fellow at the New York Public Library. Enjoys mending, maintenance & buying junk on eBay.

 - Addy, https://www.linkedin.com/in/addison-koehler-3854421b9/ Marketing Specialist, Events & Conferences (Owns the shows where many of our partners meet us)

 - Matt https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-kestufskie/ (Head of Sales), Royce https://www.linkedin.com/in/royce-christopher-6ba15b17/ (AE Manager), Derek https://www.linkedin.com/in/derek-etgen/ (SDR Manager): the front line you enable; the SDR team owns converting the leads you and the partners create into SQLs

How the marketing pod divides: the Head of Marketing sets strategy and orchestrates; you own the partner and co-op channel and its relationships, the Events & Conferences Specialist owns the conferences and regional events, and Data Science builds the enrichment, data, and attribution that all of it runs on. Marketing creates the conditions and generates MQLs; the SDR team converts them to SQLs.




COMPENSATION 💵

 - Base Salary: $131,000

 - On-Target Earnings: $150,000

 - Variable structure: the on-target variable is tied to partner-sourced pipeline you create through campaigns and partner reps.

 - Equity package: $51,000 initial grant value, vesting over 4 years




BENEFITS 🏋️

 - Full medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% of premiums for you, 50% for dependents)

 - 401k with Betterment

 - Unlimited PTO with 10 company paid holidays

 - Gym stipend

 - Daily team lunches for those in office

 - Learning materials and audiobook subscriptions

 - Dog-friendly office
   
   


ABOUT OUR FOUNDERS 🌲

 1. Andrew https://www.linkedin.com/in/beckman-andrew/ (CTO): studied computer science & humanities at Stanford, worked as a software engineer at Apple and head of engineering at Anova; danced with the SF ballet (where he met his wife)! 🩰

 2. Nick https://www.linkedin.com/in/hershey-nick/ (CEO): studied math & computer science at Stanford; worked as a trader at Bridgewater & Citadel and as a PM at Google & Enigma; distantly related to the founder of the Hershey company 🍫


HOW WE'VE FUNDRAISED 💰

We've raised $48m across four rounds:

 1. A $2m pre-seed led by Kent Bennett https://www.bvp.com/team/kent-bennett at Bessemer https://www.bvp.com/ with participation from Plug & Play, Quiet Capital, and Sequoia.

 2. A $5m seed led by Caitlin Bolnick Rellas https://www.crv.com/team/caitlin-bolnick-rellas at CRV https://www.crv.com/.

 3. An $11m series A led again by Bessemer and CRV.

 4. A $30m series B led by Battery. https://www.battery.com

The role is based in Redwood City, with regular travel to co-op markets, partner events, and stores across the country.

As the Growth Marketing Manager you will own the engine that turns marketing spend into ARR. This is one of a few Rundoo growth marketing roles, so you'll play a key role in shaping the campaigns and strategies we use in the future. Your mandate is to build on the existing demand-generation engine that turns marketing campaigns into qualified pipeline and, ultimately, ARR to help us scale spend and inbound volume into 2027. Together with the Head of Marketing, you’ll plan, launch, and optimize integrated campaigns across owned, earned, and paid channels.

Owned channels include email, website content, and social. Earned channels include third-party mentions, organic articles, and other credible coverage. Paid channels include digital ads, sponsored e-blasts, direct mail, advertorials, print placements, and other targeted media.

You’ll develop audience-focused campaigns, coordinate the right channel mix, and measure performance from engagement through qualified pipeline and closed-won revenue. Partnerships and co-marketing remain valuable parts of the mix, alongside broader demand-generation programs that reach buyers wherever they discover and evaluate Rundoo.

This is a hands-on demand generation role: you’ll build and run integrated campaigns across owned, earned, and paid channels, create and distribute campaign assets, test and refine messaging, and work closely with Sales and Marketing to improve lead quality, attribution, and pipeline results. Initial experiments and early programs are showing signs of traction and contributing to pipeline, creating a strong foundation to learn what works and scale it. You’ll report to the Head of Marketing, who brings the strategy and domain expertise and helps coordinate the team across demand generation, partnerships, and events. You’ll work alongside the Data Science team, who build the enrichment and attribution capabilities behind campaign targeting and measurement. You bring the growth instincts, creative execution, and analytical discipline to turn early momentum into a predictable demand-generation engine that drives qualified pipeline and ARR.

This is a prove-it-and-grow role. Early results point to meaningful potential across campaigns, partnerships, and conferences. As you demonstrate repeatable pipeline impact, the scope, budget, team, and level of the role can grow with it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AS THE GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER AT RUNDOO 🗒️

 - Turn marketing strategy into integrated campaigns. Work with the Head of Marketing to translate priorities, target audiences, and revenue goals into campaign plans, channel mixes, budgets, and timelines. Own day-to-day execution from launch through follow-up.

 - Run demand generation across owned, earned, and paid channels. Launch and optimize email, website content, social, digital ads, sponsored e-blasts, direct mail, advertorials, and print placements. Coordinate third-party coverage and content distribution, connecting each channel to a clear audience, message, and offer.

 - Create and distribute campaign assets. Build compelling emails, landing pages, ads, one-pagers, and case studies, working with internal teammates and vendors as needed. Carry projects from brief to delivery and keep campaigns moving on schedule.

 - Test, learn, and improve performance. Test audiences, messaging, offers, creative, and conversion paths. Use results to recommend where to scale, refine, or stop spend, in partnership with the Head of Marketing.

 - Convert interest into qualified pipeline. Build nurture and follow-up programs, and work closely with Sales and the SDR team on lead handoffs, qualification feedback, and campaign follow-through. Improve lead quality and conversion from initial engagement to sales opportunity.

 - Measure campaigns through pipeline and ARR. Maintain clear campaign tracking in Salesforce and work with Data Science on attribution and reporting. Track spend, engagement, qualified pipeline, and closed-won revenue; share actionable results and recommendations with the Head of Marketing.

 - Build a repeatable demand-generation engine. Document campaign playbooks, maintain the campaign calendar, and turn successful tests into repeatable programs. Help the Head of Marketing scale spend and inbound volume while keeping execution quality and revenue impact in focus.




REQUIREMENTS ☑️

We care more about whether you can grow pipeline and drive ARR than about a title history. The ideal candidate builds the collateral, works the relationships, and owns a revenue number rather than waiting to be handed a plan.




CORE COMPETENCIES:

 - Hands-on demand-generation marketer - you build audience-focused campaigns across owned, earned, and paid channels, building the assets and managing execution yourself

 - Pipeline and revenue focused - you connect campaign performance to qualified pipeline and closed-won ARR, using conversion data and spend efficiency to recommend improvements rather than reporting activity alone

 - Strong campaign operator - you manage briefs, budgets, timelines, and follow-up, coordinate teammates and vendors, and reliably carry campaigns from idea to launch to results

 - Collaborative across Marketing and Sales - you work with the Head of Marketing on priorities and channel mix, with Sales and SDRs on lead quality and handoffs, and with Data Science on tracking and attribution

 - Test-and-iterate mindset - you ship, test messaging, audiences, and offers, and turn what works into repeatable programs; you bring clear recommendations to the Head of Marketing and adapt quickly as you learn




VALUABLE EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years in growth marketing, demand generation, or a revenue-owning marketing role, with a demonstrable track record of driving ARR

 - Running multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns and being able to point to the pipeline and ARR they generated

 - Building branded collateral and running campaigns (e-blasts, webinars, one-pagers, magazine placements)

 - Hands-on with Salesforce: accounts, contacts, campaigns, and how pipeline is tracked and attributed

 - Working with a sales team to enable them with account intelligence i.e. MQL signals

 - SMB or owner-operator customers, and ideally distributor / co-op / buying-group ecosystems, rather than enterprise targeting




TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Comfortable in a CRM (Salesforce): accounts, contacts, campaigns, and clean partner-to-pipeline reporting

 - Comfortable with spreadsheets, lists, and outreach tooling, and with partnering with a Marketing Engineer on the enrichment behind partner-rep data

 - Able to work from Redwood City and travel to stores and events as needed

 - Comfort using AI tools to draft collateral, partner outreach, and enablement material at speed




BONUS POINTS 🌟
